disclaimer: JRE English Q1 discussion-paper phrase bank. Items may be tagged q1, q2, or common; untagged phrases stay in the Q1 set. Expand as you revise.

items.en: This may give rise to…
items.zh: 此舉可能導致…
items.example: This may give rise to longer waiting times at specialist outpatient clinics.

items.en: There could be knock-on effects on…
items.zh: 可能對…產生連鎖影響
items.example: There could be knock-on effects on frontline manpower and overtime costs.

items.en: This risks exacerbating…
items.zh: 恐會加劇…
items.example: This risks exacerbating the existing service gap in elderly care.

items.en: Left unaddressed, the problem may cascade into…
items.zh: 若不處理，問題或會蔓延至…
items.example: Left unaddressed, the problem may cascade into wider public dissatisfaction.

items.en: The fiscal implications warrant careful consideration.
items.zh: 財政影響值得審慎考慮

items.en: This could undermine public confidence in…
items.zh: 或會削弱公眾對…的信心
items.example: This could undermine public confidence in the fairness of the allocation mechanism.

items.en: A further implication is that…
items.zh: 另一影響是…

items.en: In the longer term, this may entail…
items.zh: 長遠而言，這可能意味著…

items.en: The opportunity cost of inaction should not be overlooked.
items.zh: 不作為的機會成本不容忽視

items.en: This may put additional strain on…
items.zh: 或會對…構成額外壓力
items.example: This may put additional strain on district-level service delivery.

items.en: The data points to…
items.zh: 數據顯示…
items.example: The data points to a widening gap between supply and demand.

items.en: This suggests that…
items.zh: 這意味著…
items.example: This suggests that current measures are insufficient.

items.en: A key constraint is…
items.zh: 主要限制在於…
items.example: A key constraint is limited administrative capacity.

items.en: Uptake remains subdued despite…
items.zh: 儘管…，參與／使用率仍然偏低
items.example: Uptake remains subdued despite enhanced publicity.

items.en: There is a clear shortfall in…
items.zh: 在…方面明顯不足
items.example: There is a clear shortfall in transitional housing supply.

items.en: From a cost-effectiveness perspective,…
items.zh: 從成本效益角度…

items.en: The evidence suggests that…
items.zh: 證據顯示…

items.en: Against this backdrop,…
items.zh: 在此背景下…

items.en: A trade-off exists between… and…
items.zh: 在…與…之間存在取捨
items.example: A trade-off exists between speed of delivery and thorough consultation.

items.en: The enforcement gap remains a structural concern.
items.zh: 執法缺口仍是結構性隱憂

items.en: It is recommended that a pilot be launched in…
items.zh: 建議先在…推行試點。
items.example: It is recommended that a pilot be launched in two districts.

items.en: Implementation should be phased, starting with…
items.zh: 推行宜分階段，先由…開始。

items.en: A combination of short-term relief and longer-term structural measures is preferred.
items.zh: 宜結合短期紓緩與長遠結構性措施。

items.en: Additional manpower / funding should be earmarked for…
items.zh: 應預留額外人手／撥款予…

items.en: Interdepartmental coordination should be strengthened under…
items.zh: 應在…統籌下加強跨部門協調
items.example: Interdepartmental coordination should be strengthened under a lead bureau.

items.en: Eligibility criteria should be streamlined to…
items.zh: 應精簡資格準則以…

items.en: Publicity should be stepped up to raise uptake.
items.zh: 應加大宣傳以提升參與率

items.en: Consideration may be given to scaling up subject to review findings.
items.zh: 可視乎檢討結果考慮擴大推行

items.en: A stopgap measure is needed pending a longer-term solution.
items.zh: 在長遠方案出台前需有過渡措施

items.en: Ring-fence resources to protect frontline delivery.
items.zh: 撥款應予圈定以保障前線服務

items.en: KPIs should be set to measure effectiveness.
items.zh: 應設定關鍵績效指標以量度成效。

items.en: A review should be conducted after 12 months.
items.zh: 宜於十二個月後進行檢討。

items.en: Residual risks remain and should be monitored.
items.zh: 仍有剩餘風險，應持續監察。

items.en: Uptake rates and waiting times should be tracked quarterly.
items.zh: 應每季追蹤參與率及輪候時間

items.en: Findings should be reported to… for oversight.
items.zh: 結果應向…匯報以作監察

items.en: Feedback from frontline staff and users should inform adjustments.
items.zh: 應參考前線及使用者意見作出調整

items.en: Benchmark performance against comparable jurisdictions / districts.
items.zh: 應與相若司法管轄區／地區對標

items.en: Exit criteria for the pilot should be predefined.
items.zh: 先導計劃的退出準則應預先訂明

items.en: The [bureau/department] should lead, with support from…
items.zh: 應由[政策局／部門]主導，並由…支援。

items.en: Subject to available resources, rollout can begin in…
items.zh: 視乎可用資源，可於…開始推行。

items.en: An accountable officer at directorate level should own delivery.
items.zh: 應由首長級人員問責推展

items.en: Within a 12-month timeframe,…
items.zh: 在十二個月時限內…

items.en: Subject to LegCo funding approval,…
items.zh: 視乎立法會撥款批准…

items.en: Manpower of roughly [n] posts would be required.
items.zh: 約需〔n〕個職位的人手

items.en: Non-recurrent expenditure of about $… should be sought.
items.zh: 應申請約…元的非經常開支

items.en: District-level rollout may start with [Districts A & B].
items.zh: 地區層面可先在〔甲、乙區〕推行

items.en: In view of…
items.zh: 鑒於…
items.example: In view of rising demand, additional capacity is needed.

items.en: After weighing the pros and cons…
items.zh: 權衡利弊後…

items.en: In light of the above,…
items.zh: 鑑於上述情況…

items.en: That said,…
items.zh: 話雖如此…

items.en: It is worth noting that…
items.zh: 值得注意的是…

items.en: More specifically,…
items.zh: 更具體而言…

items.en: By contrast,…
items.zh: 相比之下…

items.en: Taken together, these issues point to…
items.zh: 綜合而言，這些問題指向…

items.en: I now turn to feasible measures.
items.zh: 現轉談可行措施

items.en: For Members’ consideration.
items.zh: 供委員考慮

items.en: Option A scores higher on feasibility but lower on cost-effectiveness.
items.zh: 方案甲在可行性上較高，惟成本效益較低。

items.en: While Option B may deliver quicker results, it carries greater residual risks.
items.zh: 方案乙或可較快見效，惟剩餘風險較大。

items.en: After weighing the trade-offs, a mix of… is preferred.
items.zh: 權衡取捨後，宜採用混合方案。

items.en: This helps to… but must be accompanied by…
items.zh: 此舉有助…惟須配合…
items.example: This helps to ease congestion but must be accompanied by better public transport.

items.en: Notwithstanding the concerns raised, the benefits outweigh the risks.
items.zh: 儘管有人提出關注，利仍大於弊。

items.en: On balance, Option … better meets the criteria of effectiveness, cost and stakeholder acceptability.
items.zh: 權衡之下，方案…較能同時符合成效、成本與持份者接受度等準則。
items.note: 比較收束句；填入方案代號
items.example: On balance, Option 1 better meets the criteria of effectiveness, cost and stakeholder acceptability.

items.en: Any expansion of residential places must be matched by stronger community care, or hospital discharge will remain blocked.
items.zh: 任何院舍宿位擴張都必須配以更強的社區照顧，否則醫院出院將繼續受阻。
items.note: 院舍／社區平衡；長者題常用
items.example: Any expansion of residential places must be matched by stronger community care, or hospital discharge will remain blocked.

items.en: Pilot in two districts with the longest residential-care waiting lists, then scale subject to KPI review.
items.zh: 先在院舍輪候最長的兩個地區試點，再按 KPI 檢討後擴展。
items.example: Pilot in two districts with the longest residential-care waiting lists, then scale subject to KPI review.
